name: tile-select
prompt: A single small wooden letter tile picked up and tapped onto a wooden board, short soft knock with a light fingertip click.

name: tile-deselect
prompt: A small wooden letter tile set back down gently on a felt-lined tray, soft muted wooden tap, quieter and lower than a pick-up.

name: tray-clear
prompt: Several small wooden letter tiles swept off a board in one quick sliding motion, a brief clatter of wood pieces sliding together.

name: tray-shuffle
prompt: A handful of wooden letter tiles being shaken and shuffled around inside a small wooden tray, rattling clicks and knocks.

name: ui-click
prompt: A crisp, subtle UI button click, like a small plastic switch being pressed once, short and clean.

name: submit-invalid
prompt: A dull rejected buzz, like a rubber stamp pressed onto paper with a muted low thud and a short descending tone, conveying a gentle no.

name: word-bonus
prompt: A small celebratory sparkle, like a tiny brass bell struck once followed by a quick upward gliss of a glockenspiel, cheerful bonus reward.

name: word-complete
prompt: A satisfying success chime, like three rising notes played on a marimba with a warm wooden resonance, completing a word puzzle.

name: round-complete
prompt: A short triumphant fanfare, like a small hand bell rung twice followed by a bright rising harp arpeggio, round won celebration.

name: round-failed
prompt: A gentle descending disappointment sound, like three soft low piano notes falling in pitch with a muted wooden knock at the end, round lost but friendly.

name: hint-reveal
prompt: A soft magical reveal shimmer, like a finger circling the rim of a crystal glass with a brief rising glint, a hint appearing.

name: undo
prompt: A quick reverse swoosh, like a sheet of paper being slid back across a wooden table with a soft whoosh, undoing a move.
